text: Add impression-time request-context features tab, hour, and weekday to the neutral user/video additive scorer while leaving model, loss, and training unchanged.
rationale: The only screened feature group with positive overall primary lift and full coverage is request context, but its modest size and daily variability require confirmation.
exact_ablation: Add only the request-context feature group {tab, hour, weekday}; keep the neutral additive architecture, BCE objective, optimizer, and schedule fixed.

expected_effect.GAUC: Likely small positive lift from improved broad within-user ordering, especially for warm users/items; expect approximately +0.001 to +0.004.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Possible small positive or neutral effect because screening showed weaker top-five concentration; expect approximately -0.001 to +0.003.
